title: Observability Delegation Layer and Failure Annotator: unified trace hooks, metric enrichment, and error classification tiles
creator: Jamie Huang
description: Build a lightweight delegation layer and a Failure Annotator service that enriches incoming traces and metrics with canonical failure taxonomy tags (timeout, overload, model_error, io_error, http_4xx, http_5xx, grpc_status) and provenance fingerprints. Provide a set of dashboard tiles that expose error slices, escalation beacons, and SLO exposure by route/model so on-call and SRE can quickly triage and route remediation work.
scope: Instrument trace hook for inference runtime entry/exit to emit 'failure_context' attributes
Implement Failure Annotator microservice that consumes trace spans + request logs and emits enriched metrics and tags to metrics/log pipeline
Define canonical failure taxonomy with deterministic classification rules (sequence of heuristics + code mapping + model exception parsing)
Expose front-end dashboard tiles (Escalation Beacon, Error Provenance Timeline, SLO Exposure Grid, Model-Error Breakdown) in Console
Provide rollout path: shadow writes to new metrics namespace, opt-in experimental dashboard, then promote to primary SLO views
out_of_scope: Auto-remediation or rollback actions (not covered by this ticket)
Model-level instrumentation beyond parsing runtime exceptions (separate work with applied-ml)
Long-term storage schema changes for archived traces
success_metrics: Reduce mean time to triage (MTT) for inference failures by 30% within one month of rollout
90% classification coverage for common failure modes (timeouts, overloads, model exceptions, HTTP/gRPC codes) across 5 representative services
No more than 5% increase in trace processing latency in the metrics pipeline while in shadow mode
acceptance_criteria: Trace hook emitted on >=3 runtime entry points and is backward-compatible with existing span model
Failure Annotator produces an additional metric tag 'failure.taxonomy' and a string fingerprint 'failure.provenance' for each enriched span
Dashboards include Escalation Beacon tile and SLO Exposure Grid with route/model filters and downloadable drilldowns
Shadow writes validated for two weeks with no regression alerts before opt-in promotion
Documentation: hook spec, annotator mapping rules, dashboard guide published to Confluence
technical_notes: Trace hook: library-level middleware for runtime languages (go/python/node). Emits 'failure.hook_v' tag with version and 'failure.raw' when present

Annotator: stateless service consuming OTLP spans + structured logs from Kafka topic 'telemetry.inference.spans', enriches and republishes to 'telemetry.enriched.spans' and forwards aggregated counters to Metrics (Prometheus/SignalFx)
Classification rules: priority order - explicit model exception parsing > transport code mapping > latency/queue-depth heuristics > fallback generic error
Provenance fingerprint: sha1 of (route + model_version + primary_error_token) to cluster occurrences across services
Non-blocking path: annotated attributes are optional and default to 'unknown' when data missing
Performance: annotator will batch enrichment with 200ms window; end-to-end enrichment must add <15ms p95 to pipeline in shadow
dashboard_tiles: Escalation Beacon - single-pane color-coded alert summary for SLO-breaching routes
Error Provenance Timeline - shows provenance fingerprints over time with links to traces
SLO Exposure Grid - heatmap of SLO burn by model x route with filterable dimensions
Model-Error Breakdown - stacked bars for model exception classes and top error messages
Queue-Pressure vs Latency Scatter - bin by host pool and show overload correlation
gRPC/HTTP Harmony View - normalize HTTP and gRPC codes into unified categories
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (dev): implement local trace hook shim and unit tests (2 wks)
Phase 1 (shadow): deploy annotator to internal cluster, shadow writes to 'telemetry.enriched.spans' for 2 services (2 wks)
Phase 2 (opt-in): enable dashboard tiles for SRE and two product teams, gather feedback (1 wk)
Phase 3 (promote): enable canonical tags for all inference services and update SLO pipelines (1 wk)
Phase 4 (monitor): 30-day postmortem and metric evaluation, iterate mapping rules
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: false positives/negatives in taxonomy - Mitigation: telemetry-driven tuning, allow per-service overrides and a 'confidence' score
Risk: pipeline load increase - Mitigation: start in shadow, enable sampling, backpressure knobs on annotator
Risk: downstream dashboard dependency - Mitigation: deploy dashboards to 'experimental' namespace first and keep existing views intact
Risk: sensitive data in enriched spans - Mitigation: strip PII in trace hook and mark fields as redacted; run security review if flagged
